title: 滑雪跳台式消能工
subcategoryTitle: 壩工監測、溢洪與壓力水路
subcategoryTitleEn: Dam monitoring, spillways and pressure waterways
summary: 本課以追蹤挑流軌跡入水動量與岩床沖蝕邊界為主線，先用挑流彈道與落點與落差與飛行時間界定水力與構造條件，再將射流功率與承受區、入水動量與方向連結到福祿尺度與表面張力。彈道忽略空氣阻力且以自由射流示意，水墊與岩床反應須另外驗證。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。
summaryEn: This course develops tracing flip-bucket trajectories impact momentum and rock-scour boundaries through Jet trajectory and landing point and Drop height and flight time, then connects Jet power and receiving zone and Impact momentum and direction to Froude scaling and surface tension. Ballistic examples neglect air resistance and describe free jets; plunge-pool and rock responses require separate verification. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「挑流彈道與落點」與「落差與飛行時間」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Jet trajectory and landing point" and "Drop height and flight time": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 挑流彈道與落點：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Jet trajectory and landing point: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「挑流彈道與落點」如何影響滑雪跳台式消能工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Jet trajectory and landing point” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ski-jump spillway energy dissipation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 挑流鼻坎把高速水舌拋向下游水墊，落點受出口速度、角度與落差控制。忽略阻力的質點彈道只估中心線，實際水舌會展寬、破碎與含氣；必須確認使用的是水舌離坎速度而非上游平均速度，且不能把單一落點當成整個沖擊區。 驗證時應由高速攝影追蹤水舌邊界並核對出口速度與實際尾水高程，並辨識以下失效情境：把高水位尾水仍當同高落點會誤判沖擊位置。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「挑流彈道與落點」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A flip bucket throws a high-speed jet toward a downstream pool. Velocity, angle and elevation difference determine the ideal trajectory. A drag-free particle model estimates a centerline, while real jets spread, fragment and aerate; use launch velocity and distinguish the landing point from the entire impact footprint. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Track jet boundaries with high-speed imaging and verify launch velocity and actual tailwater elevation. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Assuming equal elevations despite high tailwater misplaces the impact region. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Jet trajectory and landing point” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Equal launch/landing elevation; V=20 m/s; angle=30 degrees; range=20**2*sin(60 degrees)/9.81=35.3119 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Equal launch/landing elevation; V=20 m/s; angle=30 degrees; range=20**2*sin(60 degrees)/9.81=35.3119 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「理想中心線落點就是完整水舌沖擊範圍」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The ideal centerline landing point defines the complete jet footprint" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「挑流彈道與落點」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Jet trajectory and landing point”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 挑流彈道與落點
knowledge.text: 挑流鼻坎把高速水舌拋向下游水墊，落點受出口速度、角度與落差控制。忽略阻力的質點彈道只估中心線，實際水舌會展寬、破碎與含氣；必須確認使用的是水舌離坎速度而非上游平均速度，且不能把單一落點當成整個沖擊區。
knowledge.textEn: A flip bucket throws a high-speed jet toward a downstream pool. Velocity, angle and elevation difference determine the ideal trajectory.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：理想中心線落點就是完整水舌沖擊範圍 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The ideal centerline landing point defines the complete jet footprint Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「滑雪跳台式消能工」的「挑流彈道與落點：機制與系統路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出流域、入流、儲存、出流與下游的水量邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「洪水量測與河道模型」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與同時間窗的流量、水位、截面與儀器校正紀錄的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Jet trajectory and landing point: mechanism and system paths” in “Ski-jump spillway energy dissipation”. Draw the catchment, inflow, storage, outflow and downstream water balance; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Flood gauging and river model” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for flow, level, section and calibration records for the same time window, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「挑流彈道與落點」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Jet trajectory and landing point" is correct?
options: 理想中心線落點就是完整水舌沖擊範圍
挑流鼻坎把高速水舌拋向下游水墊，落點受出口速度、角度與落差控制。
有落差的挑流仍可沿用同高射程公式
optionsEn: The ideal centerline landing point defines the complete jet footprint
A flip bucket throws a high-speed jet toward a downstream pool.
A jet with elevation drop still obeys the equal-elevation range formula
quiz.explanation: 挑流鼻坎把高速水舌拋向下游水墊，落點受出口速度、角度與落差控制。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A flip bucket throws a high-speed jet toward a downstream pool. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 挑流彈道與落點：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Jet trajectory and landing point: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「挑流彈道與落點」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Jet trajectory and landing point” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Equal launch/landing elevation; V=20 m/s; angle=30 degrees; range=20**2*sin(60 degrees)/9.81=35.3119 m。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Equal launch/landing elevation; V=20 m/s; angle=30 degrees; range=20**2*sin(60 degrees)/9.81=35.3119 m. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：由高速攝影追蹤水舌邊界並核對出口速度與實際尾水高程。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Track jet boundaries with high-speed imaging and verify launch velocity and actual tailwater elevation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：Equal launch/landing elevation; V=20 m/s; angle=30 degrees; range=20**2*sin(60 degrees)/9.81=35.3119 m。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Equal launch/landing elevation; V=20 m/s; angle=30 degrees; range=20**2*sin(60 degrees)/9.81=35.3119 m. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「挑流彈道與落點」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Jet trajectory and landing point", which statement holds?
options: 水舌一離開鼻坎就已經失去全部動能
水舌外觀變厚就保證液態流量已增加
原創教學假設：Equal launch/landing elevation; V=20 m/s; angle=30 degrees; range=20**2*sin(60 degrees)/9.81=35.3119 m。
optionsEn: A jet loses all kinetic energy as soon as it leaves the bucket
A thicker visible jet guarantees increased liquid discharge
Original teaching assumptions: Equal launch/landing elevation; V=20 m/s; angle=30 degrees; range=20**2*sin(60 degrees)/9.81=35.3119 m.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：Equal launch/landing elevation; V=20 m/s; angle=30 degrees; range=20**2*sin(60 degrees)/9.81=35.3119 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Equal launch/landing elevation; V=20 m/s; angle=30 degrees; range=20**2*sin(60 degrees)/9.81=35.3119 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 挑流彈道與落點：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Jet trajectory and landing point: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「挑流彈道與落點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Jet trajectory and landing point” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 由高速攝影追蹤水舌邊界並核對出口速度與實際尾水高程。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「把高水位尾水仍當同高落點會誤判沖擊位置」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Track jet boundaries with high-speed imaging and verify launch velocity and actual tailwater elevation. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Assuming equal elevations despite high tailwater misplaces the impact region. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以由高速攝影追蹤水舌邊界並核對出口速度與實際尾水高程作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對把高水位尾水仍當同高落點會誤判沖擊位置，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Track jet boundaries with high-speed imaging and verify launch velocity and actual tailwater elevation. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Assuming equal elevations despite high tailwater misplaces the impact region. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把高水位尾水仍當同高落點會誤判沖擊位置。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Assuming equal elevations despite high tailwater misplaces the impact region. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 由高速攝影追蹤水舌邊界並核對出口速度與實際尾水高程。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「把高水位尾水仍當同高落點會誤判沖擊位置」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。
knowledge.textEn: Track jet boundaries with high-speed imaging and verify launch velocity and actual tailwater elevation. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Assuming equal elevations despite high tailwater misplaces the impact region. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時以由高速攝影追蹤水舌邊界並核對出口速度與實際尾水高程作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對把高水位尾水仍當同高落點會誤判沖擊位置，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Track jet boundaries with high-speed imaging and verify launch velocity and actual tailwater elevation. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Assuming equal elevations despite high tailwater misplaces the impact region. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

quiz.question: 要驗證「挑流彈道與落點」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Jet trajectory and landing point"?
options: 由高速攝影追蹤水舌邊界並核對出口速度與實際尾水高程。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
平均壓力低就保證局部岩塊不會被拔起
optionsEn: Track jet boundaries with high-speed imaging and verify launch velocity and actual tailwater elevation.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Low mean pressure guarantees that no local rock block lifts
quiz.explanation: 由高速攝影追蹤水舌邊界並核對出口速度與實際尾水高程。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Track jet boundaries with high-speed imaging and verify launch velocity and actual tailwater elevation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 挑流彈道與落點：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Jet trajectory and landing point: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「挑流彈道與落點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Jet trajectory and landing point” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把高水位尾水仍當同高落點會誤判沖擊位置。診斷時應採取以下查核：由高速攝影追蹤水舌邊界並核對出口速度與實際尾水高程，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Assuming equal elevations despite high tailwater misplaces the impact region. Diagnose it by the following check: Track jet boundaries with high-speed imaging and verify launch velocity and actual tailwater elevation. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「理想中心線落點就是完整水舌沖擊範圍」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The ideal centerline landing point defines the complete jet footprint" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把高水位尾水仍當同高落點會誤判沖擊位置。診斷時應採取以下查核：由高速攝影追蹤水舌邊界並核對出口速度與實際尾水高程，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Assuming equal elevations despite high tailwater misplaces the impact region. Diagnose it by the following check: Track jet boundaries with high-speed imaging and verify launch velocity and actual tailwater elevation. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「挑流彈道與落點」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Jet trajectory and landing point" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把高水位尾水仍當同高落點會誤判沖擊位置。
有落差的挑流仍可沿用同高射程公式
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Assuming equal elevations despite high tailwater misplaces the impact region.
A jet with elevation drop still obeys the equal-elevation range formula
quiz.explanation: 把高水位尾水仍當同高落點會誤判沖擊位置。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Assuming equal elevations despite high tailwater misplaces the impact region. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 落差與飛行時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Drop height and flight time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「落差與飛行時間」如何影響滑雪跳台式消能工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Drop height and flight time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ski-jump spillway energy dissipation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水舌由較高出口落入低處水面時，垂直運動包含初始向上速度與重力加速，應取二次方程的正時間根。以同高公式代替會低估射程；水位波動與射流破碎使接觸面並非固定平面，仍需量測與模型確認。 驗證時應以同步影像核對離坎與入水時刻及水面平均高程，並辨識以下失效情境：選錯負時間根會產生看似有值但不具物理意義的軌跡。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「落差與飛行時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: For a jet launched above the pool, vertical motion includes initial upward velocity and gravity. Use the positive time root rather than the equal-elevation shortcut, which underestimates range. Pool waves and jet fragmentation make the contact surface variable, so measurements must validate the idealized trajectory. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Use synchronized images to verify launch and impact times and mean pool elevation. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Selecting the negative time root produces a numerical but nonphysical trajectory. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Drop height and flight time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：UpwardVelocity=10 m/s; drop=8 m; g=9.81 m/s2; flightTime=(10+sqrt(10**2+2*9.81*8))/9.81=2.65341 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: UpwardVelocity=10 m/s; drop=8 m; g=9.81 m/s2; flightTime=(10+sqrt(10**2+2*9.81*8))/9.81=2.65341 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「有落差的挑流仍可沿用同高射程公式」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A jet with elevation drop still obeys the equal-elevation range formula" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「落差與飛行時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Drop height and flight time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 落差與飛行時間
knowledge.text: 水舌由較高出口落入低處水面時，垂直運動包含初始向上速度與重力加速，應取二次方程的正時間根。以同高公式代替會低估射程；水位波動與射流破碎使接觸面並非固定平面，仍需量測與模型確認。
knowledge.textEn: For a jet launched above the pool, vertical motion includes initial upward velocity and gravity. Use the positive time root rather than the equal-elevation shortcut, which underestimates range.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：有落差的挑流仍可沿用同高射程公式 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A jet with elevation drop still obeys the equal-elevation range formula Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「落差與飛行時間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Drop height and flight time" is correct?
options: 有落差的挑流仍可沿用同高射程公式
鼻坎壓力只要用靜水深就能完整計算
水舌由較高出口落入低處水面時，垂直運動包含初始向上速度與重力加速，應取二次方程的正時間根。
optionsEn: A jet with elevation drop still obeys the equal-elevation range formula
Hydrostatic depth alone completely determines bucket pressure
For a jet launched above the pool, vertical motion includes initial upward velocity and gravity.
quiz.explanation: 水舌由較高出口落入低處水面時，垂直運動包含初始向上速度與重力加速，應取二次方程的正時間根。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: For a jet launched above the pool, vertical motion includes initial upward velocity and gravity. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 落差與飛行時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Drop height and flight time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「落差與飛行時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Drop height and flight time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：UpwardVelocity=10 m/s; drop=8 m; g=9.81 m/s2; flightTime=(10+sqrt(10**2+2*9.81*8))/9.81=2.65341 s。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: UpwardVelocity=10 m/s; drop=8 m; g=9.81 m/s2; flightTime=(10+sqrt(10**2+2*9.81*8))/9.81=2.65341 s. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同步影像核對離坎與入水時刻及水面平均高程。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use synchronized images to verify launch and impact times and mean pool elevation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：UpwardVelocity=10 m/s; drop=8 m; g=9.81 m/s2; flightTime=(10+sqrt(10**2+2*9.81*8))/9.81=2.65341 s。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: UpwardVelocity=10 m/s; drop=8 m; g=9.81 m/s2; flightTime=(10+sqrt(10**2+2*9.81*8))/9.81=2.65341 s. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「落差與飛行時間」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Drop height and flight time", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：UpwardVelocity=10 m/s; drop=8 m; g=9.81 m/s2; flightTime=(10+sqrt(10**2+2*9.81*8))/9.81=2.65341 s。
總水力功率可以單獨決定所需水墊深度
只要流速大小相同沖擊方向也相同
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: UpwardVelocity=10 m/s; drop=8 m; g=9.81 m/s2; flightTime=(10+sqrt(10**2+2*9.81*8))/9.81=2.65341 s.
Total hydraulic power alone determines required plunge-pool depth
Equal speed guarantees the same direction of impact
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：UpwardVelocity=10 m/s; drop=8 m; g=9.81 m/s2; flightTime=(10+sqrt(10**2+2*9.81*8))/9.81=2.65341 s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: UpwardVelocity=10 m/s; drop=8 m; g=9.81 m/s2; flightTime=(10+sqrt(10**2+2*9.81*8))/9.81=2.65341 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 落差與飛行時間：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Drop height and flight time: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「落差與飛行時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Drop height and flight time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以同步影像核對離坎與入水時刻及水面平均高程。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「選錯負時間根會產生看似有值但不具物理意義的軌跡」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use synchronized images to verify launch and impact times and mean pool elevation. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Selecting the negative time root produces a numerical but nonphysical trajectory. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以以同步影像核對離坎與入水時刻及水面平均高程作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對選錯負時間根會產生看似有值但不具物理意義的軌跡，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Use synchronized images to verify launch and impact times and mean pool elevation. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Selecting the negative time root produces a numerical but nonphysical trajectory. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：選錯負時間根會產生看似有值但不具物理意義的軌跡。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Selecting the negative time root produces a numerical but nonphysical trajectory. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以同步影像核對離坎與入水時刻及水面平均高程。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「選錯負時間根會產生看似有值但不具物理意義的軌跡」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。
knowledge.textEn: Use synchronized images to verify launch and impact times and mean pool elevation. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Selecting the negative time root produces a numerical but nonphysical trajectory. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時以以同步影像核對離坎與入水時刻及水面平均高程作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對選錯負時間根會產生看似有值但不具物理意義的軌跡，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Use synchronized images to verify launch and impact times and mean pool elevation. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Selecting the negative time root produces a numerical but nonphysical trajectory. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

quiz.question: 要驗證「落差與飛行時間」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Drop height and flight time"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以同步影像核對離坎與入水時刻及水面平均高程。
完整岩石強度高就保證節理岩床不沖蝕
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Use synchronized images to verify launch and impact times and mean pool elevation.
Strong intact rock guarantees a scour-proof jointed bed
quiz.explanation: 以同步影像核對離坎與入水時刻及水面平均高程。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use synchronized images to verify launch and impact times and mean pool elevation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 落差與飛行時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Drop height and flight time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「落差與飛行時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Drop height and flight time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 選錯負時間根會產生看似有值但不具物理意義的軌跡。診斷時應採取以下查核：以同步影像核對離坎與入水時刻及水面平均高程，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Selecting the negative time root produces a numerical but nonphysical trajectory. Diagnose it by the following check: Use synchronized images to verify launch and impact times and mean pool elevation. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「有落差的挑流仍可沿用同高射程公式」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A jet with elevation drop still obeys the equal-elevation range formula" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 選錯負時間根會產生看似有值但不具物理意義的軌跡。診斷時應採取以下查核：以同步影像核對離坎與入水時刻及水面平均高程，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Selecting the negative time root produces a numerical but nonphysical trajectory. Diagnose it by the following check: Use synchronized images to verify launch and impact times and mean pool elevation. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.questionEn: When "Drop height and flight time" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
